style_codes.title: Style Codes
style_codes.description: A list of 8 character hexadecimal codes representing the style of the image. Cannot be used in conjunction with style_reference_images or style

sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

image_urls.title: Image Urls
image_urls.description: A set of images to use as style references (maximum total size 10MB across all style references). The images should be in JPEG, PNG or WebP format

expand_prompt.description: Determine if MagicPrompt should be used in generating the request or not.
expand_prompt.title: Expand Prompt

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Seed for the random number generator

width.description: The width of the generated image.
width.title: Width

height.description: The height of the generated image.
height.title: Height

image_size.description: The resolution of the generated image
image_size.title: Image Size

members.title: Members
members.description: A list of color palette members that define the color palette

color_palette.description: A color palette for generation, must EITHER be specified via one of the presets (name) or explicitly via hexadecimal representations of the color with optional weights (members)

reference_image_urls.title: Reference Image Urls
reference_image_urls.description: A set of images to use as character references. Currently only 1 image is supported, rest will be ignored. (maximum total size 10MB across all character references). The images should be in JPEG, PNG or WebP format

negative_prompt.description: Description of what to exclude from an image. Descriptions in the prompt take precedence to descriptions in the negative prompt.
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

style.description: The style type to generate with. Cannot be used with style_codes.
style.title: Style

reference_mask_urls.title: Reference Mask Urls
reference_mask_urls.description: A set of masks to apply to the character references. Currently only 1 mask is supported, rest will be ignored. (maximum total size 10MB across all character references). The masks should be in JPEG, PNG or WebP format

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The prompt to fill the masked part of the image.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Seed used for the random number generator

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
